name: Verbal
description: The magical, precise incantations spoken aloud.
trade_off: You cannot cast these spells if you are gagged, unable to speak, or inside a Silence spell zone.

name: Somatic
description: The intricate hand gestures, waving, or forceful gesticulations required to weave the spell.
trade_off: Requires at least one free hand to perform. You cannot do this if you are fully paralyzed, physically restrained from moving your hands, or bound.

name: Material
description: The physical ingredients or focal objects tied to the spell.
trade_off: Requires a free hand to reach into a component pouch or hold a spellcasting focus, unless another feature says otherwise.
